_comment: The story of every cut of the promo: its scenes, how long each lasts and what the voice says over it. The video (video/src/cuts.ts), the voice-over (audio/narrate.mjs) and the captions (audio/captions.mjs) all read this file. Change a line here, then run npm run voice in video/. A line must end before its scene does: narrate.mjs stops on one that does not.

voice.en: Every release. Every browser. Every click... by hand?
voice.it: Ogni rilascio. Ogni browser. Ogni clic... a mano?

voice.en: Meet WebFlowMaster.
voice.it: Ecco WebFlowMaster.

voice.en: Record a flow by clicking through your site, or describe it in plain words. Run it, and watch it pass. No code to maintain.
voice.it: Registra un flusso cliccando sul sito, oppure descrivilo a parole. Eseguilo, e guardalo passare. Nessun codice da mantenere.

voice.en: Bring your Gherkin scenarios, and test native Android and iOS apps, from the same place.
voice.it: Porta i tuoi scenari Gherkin, e testa le app native Android e iOS, dallo stesso posto.

voice.en: Test the APIs behind the screens, too.
voice.it: Testa anche le API dietro le schermate.

voice.en: Run on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, in parallel, on dedicated runners.
voice.it: Esegui su Chromium, Firefox e WebKit, in parallelo, su runner dedicati.

voice.en: When something breaks, you see why: the failing step, the video, the trace.
voice.it: Quando qualcosa si rompe, vedi il perché: il passo fallito, il video, la traccia.

voice.en: And the whole team sees quality at a glance.
voice.it: E tutto il team vede la qualità a colpo d'occhio.

voice.en: It fits your pipeline, your repos and your issue tracker.
voice.it: Si integra con la tua pipeline, i repository e il tracker.

voice.en: Ship every release with confidence. Request a demo.
voice.it: Ogni rilascio, con fiducia. Richiedi una demo.

voice.en: Still testing every click by hand?
voice.it: Testi ancora ogni clic a mano?

voice.en: Record a flow, or describe it in plain words, and watch it pass.
voice.it: Registra un flusso, o descrivilo a parole, e guardalo passare.

voice.en: Gherkin scenarios and native apps, too.
voice.it: Anche scenari Gherkin e app native.

voice.en: On every browser, in parallel.
voice.it: Su ogni browser, in parallelo.

voice.en: And when it fails, you see why.
voice.it: E quando fallisce, vedi perché.

voice.en: WebFlowMaster. Request a demo.
voice.it: WebFlowMaster. Richiedi una demo.

voice.en: Still testing every click by hand?
voice.it: Testi ancora ogni clic a mano?

voice.en: Record it, or describe it. WebFlowMaster runs it.
voice.it: Registralo, o descrivilo. WebFlowMaster lo esegue.

voice.en: And shows you why it failed.
voice.it: E ti mostra il perché.

voice.en: Request a demo.
voice.it: Richiedi una demo.
